'''Salana''' was the leader of [[Salana's Rebels]], a cell of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] that was active on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]]. In the wake of the disappearance of the planet's [[Queen/Legends|queen]], [[Nehanna]], the Rebel Alliance supported Salana to take [[Gender/Legends|her]] place, even though she had no royal blood.<ref name="Strongholds" />
